body_markdown:
# Acadia To Participate in Jefferies 2025 Healthcare Services Conference


Posted on


[September](https://www.acadiahealthcare.com/about/news-media-events/2025/09/)[19](https://www.acadiahealthcare.com/about/news-media-events/2025/09/19/) ,[2025](https://www.acadiahealthcare.com/about/news-media-events/2025/)


by


[Acadia Healthcare](https://www.acadiahealthcare.com/about/news-media-events/author/acadia-healthcare)


Acadia Healthcare will participate in a fireside chat at the Jefferies Healthcare Services Conference on September 29-30. The conference is being held in Nashville, Tennessee, and Acadia’s presentation will be available on the company’s[Investors page](https://www.acadiahealthcare.com/investors/) September 29 beginning at 8:35 a.m. Central time.
